summary_en: Interim dividend per share increased to ¥32.00 from ¥27.00; full-year FY2027 dividend forecast raised to ¥64.00 from ¥54.00, targeting dividend payout ratio exceeding 30% by FY2031 under progressive dividend policy.
title_en: Notice Regarding Surplus Dividend (Interim Dividend - Increase) and Revision of FY2027 Dividend Forecast (Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Qol Holdings announced an interim dividend increase and upward revision of its FY2027 dividend forecast on November 5, 2026. The interim dividend per share was increased to ¥32.00 from the previously forecasted ¥27.00. Concurrently, the company raised its FY2027 full-year dividend forecast to ¥64.00 per share from ¥54.00, representing an increase of ¥10.00 per share on an annual basis.

The company positions profit distribution to shareholders as a critical management priority. The dividend increases were determined based on strong second quarter FY2027 performance relative to full-year guidance, the current operating environment, and financial condition. The company operates under a progressive dividend policy and targets achieving a dividend payout ratio exceeding 30% by FY2031.

The company did not revise its full-year earnings forecast for FY2027, citing multiple uncertainties including the impact of medical system reforms (diagnostic and drug price revisions) and the prevalence of seasonal infectious diseases. Management indicated it would announce any necessary forecast revisions promptly based on actual business progress.
